theorem ext_iff {f g : M ≃ₚ[L] N} : f = g ↔ ∃ h_dom : f.dom = g.dom,
    ∀ x : M, ∀ h : x ∈ f.dom,
    subtype _ (f.toEquiv ⟨x, h⟩) = subtype _ (g.toEquiv ⟨x, (h_dom ▸ h)⟩) := by
  constructor
  · intro h_eq
    rcases f with ⟨dom_f, cod_f, equiv_f⟩
    cases h_eq
    exact ⟨rfl, fun _ _ ↦ rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨h, H⟩; exact ext h H
